div.h6: Founding as Axion Liberal Arts College
div.p: Established by philanthropist Edmund H. Axion with an initial enrollment of 87 students across four disciplines: classics, science, theology, and law.
Following the founding of the Graduate School of Engineering and the School of Medicine, the state legislature granted full university status. Enrollment reached 4,000.
Professor Eleanor Marsh received the Nobel Prize in Chemistry for her groundbreaking work on enzyme catalysis — the first of 14 Nobel Prizes awarded to Axion scholars.
The 200-acre Innovation Campus launched with 12 research institutes and partnerships with 30 founding industry partners, establishing Axion as a world research leader.
Axion passed $1B in endowment and launched international campuses in London, Singapore, and São Paulo, serving 5,000+ students across 4 continents.

div.h6: Ranked #1 in Innovation — QS World Rankings
div.p: With 48,000 students, $400M in annual research funding, and 500,000+ alumni across 130 countries, Axion enters its next century as a global leader in education and discovery.

div.h3: Which Application Is Right for You?

div.p: Apply for a bachelor's degree program if you have not yet enrolled in a college or university after high school. Axion considers your academics, character, and potential holistically.
Advance your expertise with one of 120+ graduate programs. Most PhD applicants are considered for full funding including tuition waiver and annual stipend.
Transfer to Axion after completing coursework at another college or university. Axion accepts up to 60 transfer credits and has guaranteed transfer pathways from 30+ community colleges.
Axion welcomes students from 130+ countries. International students receive the same holistic review, and need-based financial aid is available regardless of citizenship.

div.div: Enrollment Deposit Deadline: May 1, 2026. A $500 non-refundable deposit confirms your place in the Class of 2030. Financial aid packages will be available in your applicant portal by April 1.

ul.li: Completed Common App or Axion Portal

div.p: Visit the Axion Applicant Portal at apply.axion.edu and create a free account using your email address. You can also begin via the Common Application at commonapp.org.
Fill out personal information, academic history, activities, and program choices. Save your progress at any time — your application auto-saves every 2 minutes.
Respond to one of the Common App prompts or Axion's supplemental essay question: "Describe a challenge that changed how you think. What did it teach you?" (max 650 words).
Invite recommenders directly from your portal — they'll receive a secure link. Request official transcripts from your school's registrar or guidance office. Allow 2–3 weeks for processing.

Review your application carefully before submitting. Pay the $75 fee by credit/debit card or request a fee waiver if you qualify (Common App Waiver, NACAC Waiver, or financial hardship). Submissions cannot be edited after this point.

Log in to your portal at any time to see which materials have been received, check for missing items, and view interview invitations. Decisions are released on the dates shown in the Deadlines section above.

div.h6: Accept Your Offer & Pay Your Deposit
div.p: If admitted, confirm your enrollment by May 1 and pay the $500 enrollment deposit. You'll then gain access to housing, orientation, and course registration portals — your Axion journey officially begins!

Axion's Need-Blind Admissions policy means your ability to pay is never a factor in the admission decision. 38% of students receive need-based grants averaging $28,000 per year. Submit the FAFSA and CSS Profile to be considered.

Axion awards over 500 merit-based scholarships annually ranging from $5,000 to full tuition. No separate application required — all admitted students are automatically considered based on their academic profile.
Federal Work-Study positions allow students to earn up to $3,500 per year on campus. Federal Direct Loans are available at low fixed rates for students who need additional funding beyond grants.

International students are eligible for need-based grants on the same basis as domestic students. Submit the CSS Profile and ISFAA (International Student Financial Aid Application) with your admissions application.

div.div: Average net price for families earning under $75K: $0 — Axion covers 100% of demonstrated financial need for families with household incomes below $75,000 through grants, not loans.
